# AXON

> AXON turns raw data into presentation-ready stories. Upload a file — AI extracts the insights and builds the charts, you get an editorial presentation in minutes, and you stay the author.

## What it is

AXON is an AI workspace for turning spreadsheets into clear, presentation-ready stories — without spending half a day on formatting. You upload an export, the AI finds the insights and assembles the charts, and you get a deck you can edit and own.

## Who it's for

- **Data analysts** — turn an export into a presentation you're not embarrassed to show, without burning half a day on layout.
- **Founders & managers** — make sense of the numbers and show them to investors and teams.
- **Consultants & agencies** — prepare client reports and decks faster.
- **Product & marketing** — present metrics and experiment results on a regular cadence.

## How it works

1. Upload a file (CSV or Excel).
2. The AI extracts insights and chooses the charts. The numbers are computed by code, not guessed by the AI.
3. You get an editorial presentation you can refine, rearrange, and present.

## Why it's trustworthy

- **Your numbers are real.** The AI picks and narrates; the math is done in code.
- **Your data stays private.** Only a schema and a small sample are sent for analysis — not the whole file.
- **You stay the author.** AXON drafts the story; you edit it to your judgment.
